Name: CommandCheckVoucherHandleBeforeEdit
Content:
<![CDATA[
if @@view = 0 begin
  if @@action = 'Edit' begin
    declare @$checkVoucherHandle varchar(32), @ownerID int, @fullEdit bit
    select @$checkVoucherHandle = status, @ownerID = user_id0 from @@inquiry$partition$current where stt_rec = @stt_rec
    if exists(select 1 from dmttct where ma_ct = @@id and status = @$checkVoucherHandle and xedit = 1) begin
      select @message as script, '$NotAuthorized' as message
      return
    end
    if (@@admin <> 1) and (@$checkVoucherHandle is not null) and exists(select 1 from dmttct where ma_ct = @@id and status = @$checkVoucherHandle and right_yn = 1) begin
      if not exists(select 1 from @@sysDatabaseName..sysactionrights where user_id = @@userID and ma_ct = @@id and action_id = @$checkVoucherHandle and right_yn = 1) begin
        select @message as script, '$NotAuthorized' as message
        return
      end
      if exists(select 1 from @@sysDatabaseName..sysstatusrights where user_id = @@userID and ma_ct = @@id and status_id = @$checkVoucherHandle and r_edit = 1) begin
        select @message as script, '$NotAuthorized' as message
        return
      end
    end
		if (@@admin <> 1) and (@ownerID <> @@userID) begin
			exec @@sysDatabaseName.dbo.FastBusiness$System$GetShareAccess @@id, @@userID, @@admin, 1, @fullEdit output
			if (@fullEdit = 0) begin
				select @message as script, '$NotAuthorized' as message
				return
			end
		end
  end
end
]]>

Name: CommandWhenVoucherBeforeEdit
Content:
<![CDATA[
if @@view = 0 begin
  if @@action = 'Edit' begin
    declare @$lockedDate nvarchar(512), @$denyAccess nvarchar(512), @$checkVoucherLockedDate smalldatetime, @$checkVoucherUnit varchar(32)
    select @$denyAccess = '$NotAuthorized', @$lockedDate = null, @$checkVoucherLockedDate = null
    select @$lockedDate = case when @@language = 'v' then N'Đã khóa số liệu, kiểm tra lại ngày khóa sổ.' else N'Data is locked, you must modify system locked date.' end
    select @$checkVoucherLockedDate = ngay_ct, @$checkVoucherUnit = ma_dvcs from @@inquiry$partition$current where stt_rec = @stt_rec
    if @$checkVoucherLockedDate is not null begin
      create table #lockedDate (r int)
      insert into #lockedDate exec fs20_CheckLockedDateOnVoucher @@id, @$checkVoucherLockedDate, @@userID, @$checkVoucherUnit, 1
      if not exists(select * from #lockedDate where r = 1) begin
        select @message as script, @$lockedDate as message
        return
      end
    end
    if @@admin <> 1 begin
      if not exists(select 1 from sysunitrights where user_id = @@userID and ma_dvcs = @$checkVoucherUnit and r_edit = 1) begin
        select @message as script, @$denyAccess as message
        return
      end
    end
  end
end
]]>

Name: CommandExternalFieldSet
Content:
<![CDATA[
if @@action = 'New' begin
  declare @currentDate smalldatetime
  select @currentDate = convert(char(8), getdate(), 112)
  if @voucherBook <> '' begin
    if not exists(select 1 from v20dmnk where status = 1 and ma_nk = @voucherBook and so_ct0 <> so_ct2 and (ma_dvcs = @@unit or ma_dvcs = '') and (@currentDate between ngay_hl_tu and ngay_hl_den or ((ngay_hl_tu is null and @currentDate <= ngay_hl_den) or (ngay_hl_den is null and ngay_hl_tu <= @currentDate)) or (ngay_hl_tu is null and ngay_hl_den is null)) and ma_nk in (select ma_nk from v20dmctnk where ma_ct = @@id and (lstuser = '' or charindex(rtrim(@@userName) + ',', replace(lstuser, ' ', '') + ',') > 0))) begin
      select @voucherBook = ''
    end
  end
end

if @voucherBook = '' select @currentNumber = '', @minNumber = '', @maxNumber = ''
  else select @currentNumber = rtrim(ltrim(so_ct0)), @minNumber = rtrim(ltrim(so_ct1)), @maxNumber = rtrim(ltrim(so_ct2)) from v20dmnk where ma_nk = @voucherBook
if @@action = 'New' and @@copying = 0 select @defaultExchangeRate = ty_gia from (select top 1 ty_gia from dmtgnt where ma_nt = @defaultCurrency and ngay_ct <= getdate() order by ngay_ct desc) a
]]>

if exists(select 1 from dmttct where ma_ct = @@id and status = @$checkVoucherHandle and xdel = 1) begin
  select '$NotAuthorized' as message
  return
end
if (@@admin <> 1) and (@$checkVoucherHandle is not null) and exists(select 1 from dmttct where ma_ct = @@id and status = @$checkVoucherHandle and right_yn = 1) begin
  if not exists(select 1 from @@sysDatabaseName..sysactionrights where user_id = @@userID and ma_ct = @@id and action_id = @$checkVoucherHandle and right_yn = 1) begin
    select '$NotAuthorized' as message
    return
  end
  if exists(select 1 from @@sysDatabaseName..sysstatusrights where user_id = @@userID and ma_ct = @@id and status_id = @$checkVoucherHandle and r_del = 1) begin
    select '$NotAuthorized' as message
    return
  end
end
if (@@admin <> 1) and (@ownerID <> @@userID) begin
	exec @@sysDatabaseName.dbo.FastBusiness$System$GetShareAccess @@id, @@userID, @@admin, 2, @fullDelete output
  if (@fullDelete = 0) begin
		select '$NotAuthorized' as message
		return
  end
end
]]>

declare @$lockedDate nvarchar(512), @$denyAccess nvarchar(512), @$checkVoucherLockedDate smalldatetime, @$checkVoucherUnit varchar(32)
select @$lockedDate = case when @@language = 'v' then N'Đã khóa số liệu, kiểm tra lại ngày khóa sổ.' else N'Data is locked, you must modify system locked date.' end
select @$denyAccess = '$NotAuthorized'
select @$checkVoucherLockedDate = ngay_ct, @$checkVoucherUnit = ma_dvcs from @@inquiry$partition$current where stt_rec = @stt_rec
if @$checkVoucherLockedDate is not null begin
  create table #lockedDate (r int)
  insert into #lockedDate exec fs20_CheckLockedDateOnVoucher @@id, @$checkVoucherLockedDate, @@userID, @$checkVoucherUnit, 1
  if not exists(select * from #lockedDate where r = 1) begin
    select @$lockedDate as message
    return
  end
end
if @@admin <> 1 begin
  if not exists(select 1 from sysunitrights where user_id = @@userID and ma_dvcs = @$checkVoucherUnit and r_del = 1) begin
    select @$denyAccess as message
    return
  end    
end
]]>

function create$Upload$Extender(f, key) {
  var o = $get('attachmentID');
  if (!f._upload$Extender) {
    var list = $create(FastBusiness.AjaxControlExtender.UploadExtender, {
      id: o.id + '_UploadExtender',
      parentForm: f,
      source: 'List',
      servicePath: '../AppService/UploadExtender.asmx',
      serviceMethod: 'GetListViewPage',
      uploadHandler: '../AppHandler/UploadExtender.ashx',
      downloadHandler: '../AppHandler/DownloadExtender.ashx',
      uploadField: 'fileupload',
      randomField: 'filekey',
      uploadKey: f._action == 'New' ? '' : key
    }, null, null, o);
      
    f._upload$Extender = list;
    list.add_commandEvent(listView$ExecuteCommand);
  }
}
function listView$ExecuteCommand(sender, e) {
  var action = e.type.Action;
  switch (action) {
    case 'BeforeDownload':
      sender._parentForm.request('ListTicket', 'ListTicket', []);
      break;
    default:
      break;
  }
}
]]>
